Home

Teacher as Researcher: Cultivating Literacy Routines

Micro-Credential

Issuer
National Writing Project

Description

This microcredential recognizes your work as a teacher-researcher: choosing a strategy, trying it out with your students, and reflecting on what you learned from the process. By looking closely at student responses, sharing an artifact or anecdote, and considering implications for your teaching, you are taking the first steps toward ongoing inquiry in your classroom.

Criteria

To earn the microcredential for this module, be sure your reflection includes:

  • A response that explains what you learned about your teaching and your students through this inquiry cycle.

  • A file upload of one artifact or anecdote (e.g., student work, classroom notes, a photo, or a short story) with a brief explanation of what it reveals.

  • A reflection on next steps or new questions you are taking with you as you continue your teaching and inquiry.
